name: spellkave_annotate_place
label: Annotate Place
description: Attach inert metadata (terrain.hint / custom) to a place_graph, place_node, or place_edge, and/or stamp demo H3 origin cells on a graph. Does not create playable niches yet — tags are the authoring vocabulary for later niche wiring (E prep).

namespace.description: Override namespace (default terrain.hint when terrain set, else "place.note").

h3_origin_res10.description: When target_kind=place_graph, stamp origin_cell_res10 (and anchor node cell_res10 if anchor known). Must be within Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Real H3 encoding later.

promptSnippet: Stamp terrain tags or H3 origin on place rows
promptGuidelines: terrain tags are metadata only until a niche/affordance reads them.
h3_origin_res10 is a safe-int demo stamp — not a full H3 library encode.
